model:
tff('declare_$i1',type,'fmb_$i_1':$i).
tff('declare_$i2',type,'fmb_$i_2':$i).
tff('declare_$i3',type,'fmb_$i_3':$i).
tff('declare_$i4',type,'fmb_$i_4':$i).
tff('finite_domain_$i',axiom,
      ! [X:$i] : (
         X = 'fmb_$i_1' | X = 'fmb_$i_2' | X = 'fmb_$i_3' | X = 'fmb_$i_4'
      ) ).

tff('distinct_domain_$i',axiom,
         'fmb_$i_1' != 'fmb_$i_2' & 'fmb_$i_1' != 'fmb_$i_3' & 'fmb_$i_1' != 'fmb_$i_4' & 'fmb_$i_2' != 'fmb_$i_3' & 'fmb_$i_2' != 'fmb_$i_4' & 
         'fmb_$i_3' != 'fmb_$i_4'
).

tff(e1_definition,axiom,e1 = 'fmb_$i_1').

tff(e2_definition,axiom,e2 = 'fmb_$i_2').
tff(declare_e3,type,e3:$i).
tff(e3_definition,axiom,e3 = 'fmb_$i_3').
tff(declare_e4,type,e4:$i).
tff(e4_definition,axiom,e4 = 'fmb_$i_4').
tff(declare_s1,type,s1:$i).
tff(s1_definition,axiom,s1 = 'fmb_$i_1').
tff(declare_s2,type,s2:$i).
tff(s2_definition,axiom,s2 = 'fmb_$i_1').
tff(declare_s3,type,s3:$i).
tff(s3_definition,axiom,s3 = 'fmb_$i_1').
tff(declare_s4,type,s4:$i).
tff(s4_definition,axiom,s4 = 'fmb_$i_1').
tff(declare_s5,type,s5:$i).
tff(s5_definition,axiom,s5 = 'fmb_$i_4').
tff(declare_s6,type,s6:$i).
tff(s6_definition,axiom,s6 = 'fmb_$i_3').
tff(declare_member,type,member: ($i * $i) > $o).
tff(predicate_member,axiom,
           member('fmb_$i_1','fmb_$i_1')
         & ~member('fmb_$i_1','fmb_$i_2')
         & member('fmb_$i_1','fmb_$i_3')
         & ~member('fmb_$i_1','fmb_$i_4')
         & ~member('fmb_$i_2','fmb_$i_1')
         & ~member('fmb_$i_2','fmb_$i_2')
         & ~member('fmb_$i_2','fmb_$i_3')
         & member('fmb_$i_2','fmb_$i_4')
         & ~member('fmb_$i_3','fmb_$i_1')
         & ~member('fmb_$i_3','fmb_$i_2')
         & ~member('fmb_$i_3','fmb_$i_3')
         & ~member('fmb_$i_3','fmb_$i_4')
         & member('fmb_$i_4','fmb_$i_1')
         & member('fmb_$i_4','fmb_$i_2')
         & member('fmb_$i_4','fmb_$i_3')
         & ~member('fmb_$i_4','fmb_$i_4')

).
